coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first. The current CMS Public Notices index was retrievable and showed no notice newer than September 25, 2026; no new provider termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or similar access-risk action was identified in the bounded window.

Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were completed across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural emergency-service loss, ambulance/EMS, air-medical, service restoration/reopening, U.S. territories, and general local healthcare-access closure reporting.

No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access development was identified in the window. A Seattle Children's suicide-support program page showing a September 29 program end date was not treated as a new hourly development because the closure was previously announced rather than newly reported in-window. Choate coverage was excluded as proposal/political advocacy without a newly effective service change.
